an3.11:1.1: 11 tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ñātako bhikkhu bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ
an3.11:1.3: ananulomike kāyakamme samādapeti ananumiloke vacīkamme samādapeti ananulomikesu dhammesu samādapeti
an3.11:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ñātako bhikkhu bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an3.11:2.1: tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ñātako bhikkhu bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
an3.11:2.3: anulomike kāyakamme samādapeti anulomike vacīkamme samādapeti anulomikesu dhammesu samādapeti
an3.11:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ñātako bhikkhu bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
